symptom: After the approved prerequisite-table recovery completed, the backend remained unhealthy while the existing Goals migration attempted to create its category foreign key.

evidence.primary_error: ER_FK_INCOMPATIBLE_COLUMNS: Goals.category_id and categories.category_id are incompatible.
evidence.metadata: Read-only metadata reports categories.category_id as INT signed while the existing Goals migration defines Goals.category_id as INT UNSIGNED.
evidence.previous_repair: categories, accounts and transactions now exist; receipt_id is INT UNSIGNED NULL and the receipt migration is recorded

root_cause.summary: The approved UC-13 recovery proposal specified a signed categories primary key, but the already-approved Goals schema references an unsigned category identifier. MySQL requires identical signedness for this foreign key.

actions_attempted: Built the approved recovery migration successfully.
Ran it through Docker Compose against the preserved volume.
Captured bounded logs and read-only column/migration metadata.
Stopped the stack without deleting the volume.
resolution: Researcher-approved amendment UC-13-SCHEMA-RUNTIME-001 aligned categories.category_id and transactions.category_id to INT UNSIGNED while preserving their relationship. The existing Goals migration then completed with matching signedness.
prevention: Verify referenced and referencing integer signedness together in schema proposals before creating foreign-key prerequisite tables.
